sentences.en: Michael's like, oh, my God, they like him.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔心想，天哪，他们喜欢他。

sentences.en: He clearly can't handle Dwight having a moment of success.
sentences.zh: 他显然无法接受德怀特有这么高光的时刻。

sentences.en: He leaves, and as he leaves, he walks past my character, kind of hidden in the crowd, filming Dwight.
sentences.zh: 他离开了，离开时他经过了我的角色，我当时躲在人群里拍德怀特。

sentences.en: So you know how there was a big conversation about your hair in Valentine's?

sentences.zh: 我得看起来像是隐姓埋名，但又必须能让人看清我的脸。

sentences.en: So was it written in the script that you're wearing a hat, and then Wardrobe had to come
sentences.zh: 所以剧本里写了你要戴帽子，然后服装组必须

sentences.zh: 拍下我戴帽子的照片，然后给所有相关人员看。

It's moments like this that make it so that it's not just a joke.
sentences.zh: 正是这样的时刻让他们的关系不仅仅是个笑话。

sentences.en: It's not just a joke relationship.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一段搞笑的关系。

sentences.en: These are the moments that ground it and make it real.
sentences.zh: 这些时刻让他们的关系变得扎实且真实。

sentences.en: Listen, Dwight and Angela make perfect sense to me.
sentences.zh: 听着，我觉得德怀特和安吉拉简直是天造地设。

sentences.en: They really do, just like Jim and Pam made sense to me when I read that relationship.
sentences.zh: 他们确实很般配，就像我读到吉姆和帕姆那段感情时，觉得他们在一起很有道理一样。

sentences.en: And obviously, they're going to go through some hills and valleys, but they are meant
sentences.zh: 显然，他们会经历一些起起伏伏，但他们注定

sentences.zh: 我喜欢吉姆的建议最终起到了某种帮助作用。

sentences.zh: 嗯，吉姆确实对德怀特说了些什么。

sentences.zh: 他说，只要保持真我就行。

sentences.zh: 凯莉说她想要一场六月的婚礼。

sentences.zh: 她问瑞安，他想要六月的婚礼吗？

sentences.zh: 他说，是啊，我永远不会结婚。

sentences.zh: 但随后瑞安说，我不觉得吉姆真的会去旅行。

sentences.en: Now, Paul Lieberstein, who wrote this episode, he did an interview once where he said, yeah, I think Jim did eventually take that trip, but he moved the trip.
sentences.zh: 现在，写这一集的保罗·里伯斯坦曾经在一次采访中说，是的，我觉得吉姆最终还是去了那次旅行，但他改了行程。

sentences.en: So he, well, I guess we'll get to that later.
sentences.zh: 所以他，好吧，我想我们稍后再谈这个。

sentences.en: I sort of felt like he never took the trip because he just ends up transferring jobs.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得他根本没去成那趟旅行，因为他最后只是调了工作。

sentences.zh: 他受不了德怀特表现得那么好。

sentences.zh: 所以迈克尔坐在酒吧里。

sentences.zh: 后来德怀特出来了，找到了他，开始跟他讲一个女人坐在那儿没带身份证的故事。
但德怀特讲得太投入了。

sentences.en: Dwight immediately clicks into Michael's story.
sentences.zh: 德怀特立刻就进入了迈克尔的故事节奏。

sentences.en: And Michael has this quote where he says, listen, I captivated the guy who captivated a thousand guys.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔当时说了句名言，他说，听着，我征服了那个征服了千人的男人。

sentences.en: So, like, who's the winner today?
sentences.zh: 那么，谁才是今天的赢家呢？

sentences.en: Okay, so, Ange, I had a fan question from Madeline Ethington.
sentences.zh: 好了，安吉，我收到一个来自玛德琳·埃辛顿的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: This, I've never loved male more than this male.
sentences.zh: 这个，我从来没像现在这样喜欢过男性。

sentences.en: Madeline wrote and said, I have been waiting for this episode to ask this question.
sentences.zh: 玛德琳写信说，我一直等着这一集来问这个问题。

sentences.en: At 20 minutes and 25 seconds, when Michael and Dwight are sitting at the bar, you can see a man in the background dressed like a wizard.
sentences.zh: 在20分25秒的时候，当迈克尔和德怀特坐在酒吧里时，你可以看到背景里有个男人打扮成巫师的样子。

sentences.en: And then she just wrote again, who is that wizard?
sentences.zh: 然后她又写道，那个巫师到底是谁？

sentences.en: I know the answer to this.
I went, I was like, this is the strangest question.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这问题也太奇怪了。

sentences.en: I went to 20 minutes, 25 seconds, and I laughed out loud.
sentences.zh: 我看了20分25秒的那段，直接笑出声来。
从头到脚全套巫师装扮。

sentences.en: I know why, but I know why because I watched the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 我知道原因，但我知道是因为我看了删减片段。

sentences.en: Oh, I know why because I asked Kent Sabornak and Paul Lieberstein, why is there a man dressed as a wizard in the background?
sentences.zh: 噢，我知道原因，因为我问过肯特·萨博纳克和保罗·李伯斯坦，为什么背景里有个穿成巫师的人？

sentences.en: So you tell me what you found out, and I'll tell you what I found out.

sentences.en: He's got a name tag on.

sentences.en: and there is an extended scene of them walking through the hotel where the convention centers are.
sentences.zh: 里面有一段他们穿过会议中心所在酒店的加长片段。

sentences.en: And they go up to the very first one they see, and they walk in, and it's the wrong one.
sentences.zh: 他们走到看到的第一个房间，走进去，结果走错了。

sentences.en: And it's like just some random convention.
sentences.zh: 那只是个随便什么会议。

sentences.en: And then they go into a second room, and it's like all of these cosplay people who are dressed like characters from things.
sentences.zh: 然后他们进了第二个房间，里面全是那些打扮成各种角色的人。

sentences.en: And Dwight's like, oh, I wish I, oh, I wanted to go to this.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，噢，我真希望，噢，我本来想去这个的。

sentences.en: It has like a whole name.
sentences.zh: 它好像有个完整的名字。

sentences.en: But Dwight was like, I would have gone.
sentences.zh: 但德怀特说，我本来会去的。

sentences.en: And then he's like, I really hope I see the gal from Battlestar Galactica.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我真希望我能见到《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》里的那个姑娘。

sentences.en: This must have been improvised because Kent told me that their location agreement with the Sheridan allowed them to shoot basically anywhere on the property.
sentences.zh: 这肯定是即兴发挥的，因为肯特告诉我，他们与喜来登酒店的场地协议允许他们在酒店内几乎任何地方拍摄。

sentences.en: But the only room they were allowed to shut down and control was that ballroom.
sentences.zh: 但他们唯一被允许封闭和控制的房间就是那个宴会厅。

sentences.en: And otherwise, they just had those signs up that said, if you walk in this area, you might be filmed for a TV show.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他们只是立了些牌子，上面写着，如果你走进这个区域，你可能会被拍进电视节目里。

sentences.en: And by walking in this area, you give permission to be on the TV show.
sentences.zh: 并且走进这个区域，即视为你同意出现在电视节目中。

sentences.en: I don't know if you guys outside of L.A., you see these signs a lot around town.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们洛杉矶以外的人，你们在城里经常看到这种牌子吗？

sentences.en: Because you're just living your life.
sentences.zh: 因为你只是在过自己的生活。

sentences.en: And there's like a sign, and you're like, oh, they're filming on the street, and I'm going to be in the background getting my coffee, I guess.
sentences.zh: 然后有个牌子，你会想，噢，他们在街上拍戏，我想我会被拍进背景里去买咖啡吧。

sentences.en: So, I guess then Rain and Steve improvised this whole thing that it was like a cosplay convention.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想雷恩和史蒂夫当时即兴发挥，把这编成了个角色扮演大会。

sentences.en: And Rain was really, really bummed because, well, Dwight was really bummed because he had wanted to go to it.
sentences.zh: 雷恩当时真的很沮丧，因为，嗯，德怀特真的很沮丧，因为他本来想去参加那个展的。

sentences.en: And supposedly, there was a Battlestar Galactica cast member that was going to be there, and he was like really excited.
sentences.zh: 而且据说《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》的一位演员会去那里，他当时真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: Well, both Kent and Paul said a version of the same thing, which was they really tried to avoid getting the dressed up people in the shots.
sentences.zh: 嗯，肯特和保罗说的版本差不多，他们确实尽量避免把那些打扮的人拍进镜头里。

sentences.en: But this one wizard managed to get on camera.
sentences.zh: 但这个巫师还是设法闯进了镜头。

sentences.en: And maybe they had to film that little improv to justify it if they, like too many of them showed up at one time.
sentences.zh: 也许他们不得不拍那段即兴表演来圆场，以防太多人同时出现。

sentences.zh: 我们当时是为了参加大会住在那儿的。

sentences.zh: 2007年有个办公室大会，整个剧组都住在那儿。

sentences.en: So if you're in Scranton, I recommend the Radisson Lackawanna Station Hotel.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你去斯克兰顿，我推荐雷迪森拉卡瓦纳车站酒店。

sentences.en: So I've also stayed there, and I concur.
sentences.zh: 所以我也住过那儿，我表示赞同。

sentences.en: So now Dwight and Michael are sort of having this great moment at the bar.
sentences.zh: 现在德怀特和迈克尔在酒吧里度过了一段很棒的时光。

sentences.en: They're laughing, and it's all wrapping up.
sentences.zh: 他们在大笑，一切都要结束了。

sentences.en: But guess who's the last person to touch the thermostat back in the office?
sentences.zh: 但你猜办公室里最后一个碰恒温器的人是谁？

sentences.zh: 克里德走过去调了恒温器。

sentences.zh: 我买了张不可退款的票。

sentences.en: And this is when he tells us he bought his ticket for June 8th.
sentences.zh: 就在这时他告诉我们他买了6月8号的票。

sentences.en: Oh, the look on Pam's face.
I mean, this is so telling.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太能说明问题了。

sentences.en: I mean, Pam, if Pam had any doubts at all that this was hard on him, she can't deny it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我是说，帕姆，如果帕姆之前对这件事让他感到痛苦还有任何怀疑的话，现在她无法再否认了。

sentences.en: He has basically said to her, I'm sorry, but I cannot be there when you marry someone else.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在告诉她，对不起，当你嫁给别人的时候，我无法在场。

sentences.en: In fact, I have to be on basically the farthest spot on the earth from your wedding.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我必须去地球上离你婚礼最远的地方。

sentences.en: I'm going to go halfway around the world to get away from your wedding.
sentences.zh: 我要去地球的另一端，远离你的婚礼。

sentences.en: I mean, it just gutted me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这真的让我心碎。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to shake Pam and be like, if you don't know now, then you'll never know.
sentences.zh: 我真想摇醒帕姆，告诉她，如果你现在还不明白，那你永远都不会明白了。

sentences.en: But I think it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为不仅仅是这样。

sentences.en: I think what's happening is Jim is saying, I'm not sure how to even be your friend now that you're getting married.
sentences.zh: 我觉得吉姆是在说，既然你要结婚了，我甚至不知道该怎么做你的朋友了。

sentences.en: Like, I know we're best friends at the office, but I'm not going to come to your wedding.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们在办公室是最好的朋友，但我不会去参加你的婚礼。

sentences.en: And when you're married, I'm not going to hang with you.
sentences.zh: 等你结婚后，我也不会再和你混在一起了。

sentences.en: I think what he's finally admitting is they're not best friends.
sentences.zh: 我想他最终承认的是，他们并不是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: They've had that moment on Booze Cruise.
sentences.zh: 他们在“酒水游轮”上经历过那一刻。

sentences.en: They've had these moments now, and the line has been crossed.
sentences.zh: 他们现在有了这些时刻，界限已经被打破了。

sentences.en: And now they're in this uncharted territory of, like, what do we do now?
sentences.zh: 现在他们进入了一个未知的领域，就像，我们现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: Take Your Daughter to Work Day, I think.
This is when, you guys, I was wrong.
So I'll get the time code for that so I can really lay into myself.
sentences.zh: 我会找出那段的时间码，这样我就能好好数落自己一番了。

sentences.en: Yeah, Take Your Daughter to Work Day is coming up next week.
sentences.zh: 没错，“带女儿上班日”下周就要播了。

sentences.en: All right, you guys, that was Dwight's speech.
sentences.zh: 好了，伙计们，刚才那是德怀特的演讲。
